title: EDC Brasil 2015 Official Trailer
description:
Get your tickets now! http://insom.co/edcBrasil
 
It’s time to make history! On December 4 & 5, 2015, the fantastical world of Electric Daisy Carnival will touch down in São Paulo for our very first South American expedition. Insomniac will bring its signature experience and cutting-edge production for two days of super blooming beats and funkdafied freaks. Join tens of thousands of your fellow Headliners, performers, night owls and music-lovers at Autódromo de Interlagos as we celebrate EDC Under the Electric Sky!
